result.summary: Hard-gate re-validation failed: build/test commands pass and TC-EXP-301-05 is strengthened, but EXP-301 spec-to-implementation completeness is still incomplete (TC-EXP-301-11 and TC-EXP-301-12 missing) and fixture-isolation conventions are not fully met in effects integration tests.

issues.description: Spec/implementation mismatch for EXP-301 completeness: tests/specs/EXP-301.md defines TC-EXP-301-11 and TC-EXP-301-12, but tests/integration/effects_subsystem_test.zig contains only TC-EXP-301-01..10.
Hard-gate case-count check fails: EXP-301 spec has 12 test cases while implemented integration tests provide 10, violating no-gap requirement for MUST coverage.

Fixture-isolation convention gap: several integration tests use static token/correlation literals (for example tok_001 and TASK_1:tok_001) instead of per-test unique fixture IDs everywhere, increasing cross-test collision risk.

result.next_action: Route back to TEST-DESIGNER for rework; add TC-EXP-301-11/12 integration tests and harden fixture uniqueness patterns, then resubmit TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR.
